# Application Insights Web

Use this skill for browser-side telemetry in React or other web apps.

## Covers

- page views and route tracking
- AJAX/fetch dependency telemetry
- exceptions and custom events
- telemetry initializers and filtering
- React framework integration

## Workflow

1. Check current Microsoft docs for the SDK setup.
2. Initialize the SDK early in app startup.
3. Correlate browser traces with backend telemetry when needed.
